question: Should this Zalo sanitizer PR wait for redacted live Zalo delivery proof, or may maintainers override the proof gate and merge on focused tests plus sibling-channel precedent?
rationale: The code path is narrow and source-backed, but the contributor explicitly lacks a credentialed Zalo test account and external PR policy requires real behavior proof unless a maintainer intentionally accepts the remaining delivery uncertainty.

options.title: Require Live Zalo Proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted Zalo transcript, screenshot, recording, terminal output, or logs showing the trace line stripped and ordinary text preserved before merge.

options.title: Override Based On Siblings
options.body: Merge on the small diff, focused tests, and sibling-channel precedent while accepting that real Zalo delivery remains unproven until after merge.

options.title: Pause For Shared Boundary
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers want the umbrella issue solved by one shared outbound sanitizer default instead of per-channel hooks.

recommendation.title: Require Live Zalo Proof
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted Zalo transcript, screenshot, recording, terminal output, or logs showing the trace line stripped and ordinary text preserved before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc has the clearest current history across the Zalo adapter, shared outbound delivery, and SDK sanitizer boundary involved in this proof-gate decision.
